description: Chain delay: no date can be given. Two commitments by the fee earner.

segments.text: Our buyers' purchase is delayed, isn't it? Have we got a completion date yet?
Not yet, I'm afraid. The seller of the house your buyers are buying is waiting on their own searches, so the chain can't fix a date.
This is really stressful. We've already given notice on the rental.
I understand. I'll phone the chain solicitor tomorrow and I'll update you by Thursday whatever the answer is.
